source.creator: 3D Education Engine
source.attribution: Educational model generated procedurally by 3D Education Engine, based on textbook descriptions of cardiomyocyte ultrastructure.

educational.disclaimer: Educational model — not to scale. About 100 µm long; only some myofibrils and mitochondria are drawn.

sarcolemma.name: Cell membrane (sarcolemma)
sarcolemma.description: The cell membrane of a muscle cell.

nucleus.name: Nucleus
nucleus.description: Holds the cell's DNA; placed centrally in cardiac muscle cells.

myofibrils.name: Myofibrils
myofibrils.description: Long bundles of actin and myosin filaments. The filaments slide past each other to shorten the cell.

z_discs.name: Z-discs (sarcomere boundaries)
z_discs.description: Mark the ends of each sarcomere, the ~2 µm contractile unit. They line up across the myofibrils, which is why the cell looks striped.

mitochondria.name: Mitochondria
mitochondria.description: Make ATP by aerobic respiration. In heart muscle cells they take up roughly a third of the cell's volume.

intercalated_discs.name: Intercalated discs
intercalated_discs.description: Join this cell to its neighbours, mechanically (desmosomes) and electrically (gap junctions).
